course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Numbers, dates and strings: separate value from presentation
goal: Separate values from presentation and explain units in date arithmetic.

prerequisites.text: The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.

sections.title: Quantity, presentation and unit
paragraphs: Number 12.5 stores a quantity; string "12.50" stores a chosen representation. A trailing display zero adds no precision to the numeric value. Format for a person or an agreed text interface, while calculations continue to use numbers rather than decorative strings.

Calculation value, displayed string and measurement unit are separate parts of an explanation. Displayed 12.50 alone says neither money, hours nor ratio. Стоимость is a training number here; real payments additionally require currency, rounding and an agreed operation meaning.

sections.title: Trace the main example
paragraphs: Формат returns a string; date addition and subtraction use seconds.

code.output: Two messages: string “12.50” and number 60 seconds.

sections.title: Formatting is not input parsing
paragraphs: ЧДЦ=2 requests two decimal places, ЧРД=. selects a dot and ЧГ=0 disables digit grouping. These options govern this output only. They do not define a universal parser for financial input: currency, rounding and accepted representations are separate requirements.

Use ТипЗнч to compare the original number and resulting string when uncertain. Формат options govern the selected output. Parsing someone else’s string is another task whose representation may differ. A function name is no proof of universal locale support.

sections.title: Calendar components and seconds
paragraphs: Дата(2026, 10, 31, 9, 30, 0) explicitly lists year, month, day, hour, minute and second. It avoids guessing the meaning of text such as 01/02. Adding 60 to this date adds seconds, not minutes; subtracting date values returns seconds.

Date components must form a valid calendar date, not merely six arbitrary numbers. October 31 exists; an impossible date must not silently become another date. The exercise fixes its start explicitly. Adding 60 changes time by one minute; crossing midnight also changes the day, so compare date and time together.

sections.title: Convert minutes into seconds
paragraphs: Using 15 alone would add only 15 seconds.

sections.title: Repeatability and scope
paragraphs: A time zone, calendar transition or business duration cannot be inferred merely from matching displayed dates. This short example checks arithmetic of the selected values. International exchange later specifies time representation and meaning explicitly. Use no external services or real payments in this exercise.

Record the exact start, addition in seconds, formatting string and actual messages. This example establishes no universal time-zone or international-exchange behavior. Later function and exchange contracts will be explicit, preserving input and errors without guessing.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: Formatting changed the original number. It created a separate string; Стоимость remains numeric 12.5.
Adding 15 to a date adds 15 minutes. This arithmetic adds seconds; multiply minutes by 60.

Convert 15 minutes explicitly by multiplying by 60.
